deadline.value: Apply by December 3, 2026 (11:59pm CST) for Fall 2027; fall entry only.
deadline.quote: The application deadline for Fall 2027 Astronomy Ph.D. admission is December 3, 2026 at 11:59pm CST.

gre_subject.value: The Physics GRE is not required and is not considered if sent.
gre_subject.quote: neither general GRE nor physics GRE scores are required and, if submitted, will not be considered in our evaluation of the applicant.

gre_general.value: The General GRE is not required and is not considered if sent.
gre_general.quote: neither general GRE nor physics GRE scores are required and, if submitted, will not be considered in our evaluation of the applicant.

supervisor.value: An admissions committee reads applications; no advisor commitment is needed, but name several faculty you'd like to work with (emailing them first is welcome).
supervisor.quote: Applications are read by the graduate admissions committee. You do not need to have an advisor lined up before you apply, and you do not need a commitment from anyone.

funding.value: Admitted PhD students get a four-year funding commitment (three years if you already have a year of graduate work), subject to progress; Fall 2027 cohort will be smaller than normal.
funding.quote: Our Astronomy Ph.D. Program comes with a four year commitment of financial support, pending satisfactory progress and funding availability. | The Department of Astronomy plans to admit a smaller than normal cohort of students for Fall 2027.

also.quote: The length of guaranteed student support is four continuous years for those with no prior graduate work.

entry_route.value: Apply from a bachelor's with at least three years of college physics and maths through differential equations; terminal master's admits are rare.
entry_route.quote: To enter as a graduate student, an applicant must have undergraduate preparation that includes at least three years of college physics and mathematics through differential equations.

fee_waiver.value: The department gives a few fee waivers to applicants not eligible for Graduate School fee grants (so internationals can apply); request by November 22, 2026.
fee_waiver.quote: The Astronomy Department gives out a few fee waivers to students who are not eligible to receive the ones the UW provides above. | The form to apply is open until November 22, 2026.

notes: Faculty recruiting for Fall 2027 are listed on the prospective-students page.
